PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_di.rule: Source state mirrors ConsumeLiquidFilter display stats.add with booster/input stat selection, amount * 60f display amount, true perSecond flag, and StatValues.liquids rows; live UI Table mutation and concrete Liquid binding deferred.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_co.rule: Source state mirrors typed ConsumeLiquidFilter constructor fields and assignments while treating Boolf<Liquid> as an explicit handle until concrete Liquid predicates are ported.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_ap.rule: Source apply sets block.hasLiquids true and marks liquidFilter for each explicitly filtered liquid id selected by content.liquids().each(filter, ...), without executing Boolf<Liquid> yet.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_de.rule: Source no-arg ConsumeLiquidFilter constructor has an empty body and leaves the field initializer public Boolf<Liquid> filter = l -> false; intact; no amount or predicate execution is invented.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_ge.rule: Source getConsumed first returns build.liquids.current() when filter.get(current) and currentAmount > 0, then scans content.liquids() for first filter.get(liq) with build.liquids.get(liq) > 0; Boolf<Liquid> results and liquid amounts are explicit inputs until concrete Liquid binding is ported.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_up.rule: Source update gets Liquid liq = getConsumed(build), only removes liquid when liq != null, and removes amount * build.edelta() * multiplier.get(build); consumed_liquid and multiplier result are explicit inputs until concrete Building/Liquid/Floatf binding is ported.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_ef.rule: Source efficiency gets consumed liquid, reads build.edelta(), returns 0 when ed <= 0.00000001f, otherwise returns Math.min(build.liquids.get(liq) / (amount * ed * multiplier.get(build)), 1f) when liq != null, else 0; consumed_liquid, liquid amount, and multiplier result are explicit inputs until concrete Building/Liquid/Floatf binding is ported.

Generated bridge models exact ConsumeLiquidFilter.efficiencyMultiplier ternary from local getConsumed liquid result to liquidEfficiencyMultiplier result; consumed_liquid and liquid_efficiency_multiplier remain explicit inputs until live Building/getConsumed and override dispatch are ported.

PortGame.source_consume_liquid_filter_bu.rule: Generated bridge models exact ConsumeLiquidFilter.build MultiReqImage list construction; filtered_liquid_ids and consumed_liquid remain explicit inputs until live content.liquids(), Liquid uiIcon objects, and getConsumed(Building) dispatch are ported.
